title: PxDeathSwap
description: A simple 2v2 death swap plugin for Minecraft
body:
🔄 **PxDeath:2v2 Competitive Death Swap**

PxDeathSwap is a fast-paced and competitive 2v2 Death Swap plugin for Paper / Bukkit 1.20+. Designed for intense PvP and strategy-based gameplay, this plugin swaps players at random intervals, forcing teams to outsmart their opponents and survive at all costs.

Perfect for events, YouTube challenges, SMP games, and tournaments.


To report any issues and bugs join my discord and open an ticket
https://discord.gg/C7sVU3AANj


---

⚔️ Features

2v2 Team-Based Death Swap

Random player swaps at configurable time intervals

Automatic team assignment or manual setup

Fully configurable via config.yml

BossBar & ActionBar alerts before swaps

Safe teleport handling to prevent glitches

Death detection system – first team to die loses

Commands & permissions support

Optimized for Paper 1.20+



---

⚙️ How It Works

1. Players are divided into two teams (2v2)


2. Every set interval, players are randomly swapped with an enemy


3. Use traps, lava, fall damage, or strategy to eliminate opponents


4. The last surviving team wins




---

🧩 Commands

/pxdeathswap start
/pxdeathswap stop
/pxdeathswap join <team>
/pxdeathswap reload


---

📁 Configuration

Swap time (seconds)

Countdown warnings

Damage protection after swap

World whitelist

Messages & titles


All settings can be customized in config.yml


---

📦 Requirements

Paper / Spigot 1.20+

Java 17+


🎮 Ideal For

Minecraft Events

YouTube & Streaming Challenges

Competitive SMPs

Mini-game servers
